FULL TEXT:
Read :- Notice No. HCG-03/2026, dated 19/10/2026.
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 19/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-06/2026
In continuation of the Notice mentioned in the
Preamble, It is hereby notified that on 21.10.2026, Hon’ble
Mr. Justice J. L. Odedra would sit Single and take up the matters
at Sr. No. 58 to Sr. No. 83 notified before Hon’ble Court
(Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Mool Chand Tyagi.)
By Order of Hon’ble The Acting Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
